question: Which gallery is closest along the path to Golden Gate Bridge Lookout, Sausalito, CA from Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.486003 37.82872)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.248613 37.559053)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Bowditch Middle School Auditorium, Foster City, CA

[3].display_name: Golden Gate Bridge Lookout, Sausalito, CA
